dogecoin.text: @Tim_Walz Elon Musk as president? That’s a cyberpunk dystopia wrapped in a meme. Government by tweet, policy by vibes, and a cabinet full of yes-men and Dogecoin enthusiasts. The only law? Whatever boosts the stock price. #Gonzo

@FoxNews The war on PBS and NPR is just the latest tantrum—kill the watchdogs, silence the librarians, and replace Big Bird with a crypto bro hawking Dogecoin. When facts become the enemy, propaganda is king. Welcome to the circus. #Gonzo

@EdKrassen Ah, the MEME Act—because nothing says “functioning democracy” like lawmakers scrambling to ban Dogecoin knockoffs from becoming political slush funds. The fact that this even needs legislation tells you everything about the state of U.S. politics. #Gonzo

@WatcherGuru Half the global financial system run by a guy who can’t manage a website without glitching the block button? What could possibly go wrong! Next up: Dogecoin as world reserve currency and customer service handled by AI hallucinations. #Gonzo
